name: coffee
title: Coffee
description: Keep your machine awake — indefinitely, for a duration, until a time, while an app runs, or on a weekly schedule.
author: tiagemiguel

commands.name: coffee
commands.title: Coffee
commands.subtitle: Coffee
commands.description: See caffeination status and control it from one place

commands.name: decaffeinate
commands.title: Decaffeinate
commands.subtitle: Coffee
commands.description: Allow the machine to sleep again

commands.name: caffeinate-for
commands.title: Caffeinate For
commands.subtitle: Coffee
commands.description: Keep the machine awake for a set duration

commands.name: caffeinate-until
commands.title: Caffeinate Until
commands.subtitle: Coffee
commands.description: Keep the machine awake until a time. Type 5pm, or pick a date.

commands.name: caffeinate-while
commands.title: Caffeinate While
commands.subtitle: Coffee
commands.description: Keep the machine awake while an app or process is running

commands.name: schedule
commands.title: Schedule Caffeination
commands.subtitle: Coffee

preferences.name: prevent-display
preferences.title: Inhibit
preferences.description: Prevent the display from sleeping (idle inhibit / caffeinate -d)
preferences.label: Prevent display sleep

preferences.name: prevent-system
preferences.description: Prevent the system from sleeping (sleep inhibit / caffeinate -i)
preferences.label: Prevent system sleep

preferences.name: prevent-lid
preferences.description: On Linux, also block sleep when the lid is closed.
preferences.label: Prevent lid-close sleep (Linux)

preferences.name: prevent-disk
preferences.description: On macOS, prevent the disk from idle-sleeping (caffeinate -m).
preferences.label: Prevent disk sleep (macOS)
